result.description:
Port Hedland / Karratha, Full Time, Heavy Equipment Operation
Vacancy Listing Dates 30/06/2026 to 28/07/2026
Please Quote Reference Number 17405
- Highly skilled Excavator Operators wanted
- Remuneration - $80,000 - $100,000
- Join Dodd & Dodd Group - Port Hedland and Karratha

Dodd and Dodd Group Pty Ltd has over 50 years experience in dedicated scrap metal recycling throughout Western Australia. We consider ourselves market leaders for safe recycling, as well as on-site specialists for extensive clean-ups and responsible salvaging. Our specialty is effective site waste management, including hazardous waste. Our clientele range from small commercial developers right up to large mining ventures.

We are currently seeking experienced and highly skilled Excavator Operators to join our team in Karratha, and Port Hedland, WA.

Duties will include:
- Operation and maintenance of a range of various sized excavators
- Fitting of appropriate attachments including shears, magnets and various types of specialist grabs
- Safe and efficient of use of attachments using hydraulic controls
- Moving, processing and loading of various materials ( namely scrap metal ) using shears and specialist grabs
- Ensuring that all equipment is maintained and operated in a safe and efficient manner, and in accordance with OEM specifications whilst adhering to company policies including OH&S
- Work closely with other members of the team and observing their verbal and visual instructions
- Perform routine maintenance, refuelling and repair tasks on equipment, and report any defects or issues to the appropriate personnel
- Complete all necessary paperwork and documentation, including time sheets, inspection reports, and maintenance records

To be considered for this position, you will need to demonstrate at two years full time experience, and hold relevant certificates.

These are full time positions based in either Karratha or Port Hedland.

Remuneration packages between $80,000 - $100,000 will be offered to the successful candidates.

APPLY NOW through our online application form - https://www.netyourjob.com.au/jobs/17405.php

result.description:
A busy community practice in  Revesby  is seeking a  General Practitioner  to assist with its high patient demand. This is an ideal opportunity for a GP to build a patient base from day one while benefiting from industry-leading practice management support. A locum opportunity is also available. 

 The centre is a mixed-billing community practice with a diverse patient base, including a mix of young and elderly patients from varied cultural backgrounds. The practice fosters a vibrant and supportive work culture where GPs and staff work together in a friendly, collaborative, and approachable environment. The centre is conveniently located, just a two-minute walk from the train station and nearby shops. It features 12 consultation rooms and a well-equipped, five-bay treatment room. For patient convenience, the centre offers on-site allied health services, including physiotherapy, psychology, and podiatry, as well as an on-site pharmacy. 

 GPs are provided with clinical autonomy and flexible working arrangements, supported by experienced nurses and dedicated administrative teams. The practice offers dedicated nursing support for the treatment room and Chronic Disease Management (CDM) care plans. Professional growth is encouraged through opportunities to become a GP Registrar supervisor, and a partnership with the RACGP simplifies the process of achieving and recording CPD requirements. Free in-house CPD opportunities and discounted registration for industry events are also available. Practitioners with a special interest in areas such as skin, aesthetics, and occupational medicine are supported. The practice is backed by a major healthcare division, providing sophisticated IT, marketing, and finance services with 24-hour IT support, ensuring a smooth and efficient practice environment.   Apply Now
